mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_profile ( member_id, company_name, business_number, representative_name, industry, company_address, company_detail_address, company_phone, website_url, logo_url, company_description, employee_count, established_date, verification_status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{companyName}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{industry}, #{companyAddress}, #{companyDetailAddress}, #{companyPhone}, #{websiteUrl}, #{logoUrl}, #{companyDescription}, #{employeeCount}, NULLIF(#{establishedDate}, ''), 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT C.id, C.member_id, C.company_name, C.business_number, C.representative_name, C.industry, C.company_address, C.company_detail_address, C.company_phone, C.website_url, C.logo_url, C.company_description, C.employee_count, C.established_date, C.verification_status, C.created_at, C.updated_at, M.login_id, M.name, M.role FROM company_profile C, member M WHERE C.member_id = M.id AND C.member_id = #{memberId}
